source_js: const visual = { prepare: function (input) { return [{ kind: 'text', payload: '拔塞过程三阶段（示意）' }, { kind: 'text', payload: 'u = x / h = 0, 1/2, 1' }, { kind: 'text', payload: '位移按比例；u=1 时木塞底部到达瓶口' }, { kind: 'text', payload: '瓶口基准线' }, { kind: 'text', payload: 'h' }, { kind: 'text', payload: 'x' }, { kind: 'text', payload: 'x' }, { kind: 'text', payload: 'u = 0' }, { kind: 'text', payload: 'u = 1/2' }, { kind: 'text', payload: 'u = 1' }, { kind: 'text', payload: '初始底部位' }]; }, render: function (input, metrics) { var W = input.viewport.widthDu; var H = input.viewport.heightDu; var margin = W * 0.06; var gap = W * 0.045; var panelW = (W - 2 * margin - 2 * gap) / 3; var centers = [margin + panelW / 2, margin + panelW + gap + panelW / 2, margin + 2 * (panelW + gap) + panelW / 2]; var y0 = H * 0.42; var h = H * 0.30; var c = h * 0.55; var neckHalf = Math.min(panelW * 0.22, W * 0.07); var corkHalf = neckHalf * 0.72; var neckDepth = h + H * 0.08; var initialY = y0 + h; var stageLabelY = H * 0.89; var dark = '#26354a'; var corkColor = '#c98b4b'; var baselineColor = '#8a97a8'; var refColor = '#b9c4d2'; var paths = []; var children = []; function addPath(id, commands, fill, stroke) { paths.push({ id: id, commands: commands }); var node = { type: 'path', pathId: id, fill: fill }; if (stroke) { node.stroke = stroke; } children.push(node); } function addLabel(contentId, x, y, hAlign, vAlign, color) { children.push({ type: 'label', contentId: contentId, anchor: { x: x, y: y }, hAlign: hAlign, vAlign: vAlign, color: color }); } addPath('baseline', [['M', margin, y0], ['L', W - margin, y0]], baselineColor, { width: 1.5, dash: [7, 5] }); addPath('initial-ref', [['M', margin, initialY], ['L', W - margin, initialY]], refColor, { width: 1.5, dash: [4, 6] }); var us = [0, 0.5, 1]; for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { var cx = centers[i]; var left = cx - neckHalf; var right = cx + neckHalf; addPath('neck-' + i, [['M', left - 10, y0], ['L', left, y0], ['M', left, y0], ['L', left, y0 + neckDepth], ['M', right + 10, y0], ['L', right, y0], ['M', right, y0], ['L', right, y0 + neckDepth]], dark, { width: 3, cap: 'round', join: 'round' }); var u = us[i]; var bottomY = y0 + h * (1 - u); var topY = bottomY - c; var cl = cx - corkHalf; var cr = cx + corkHalf; addPath('cork-fill-' + i, [['M', cl, topY], ['L', cr, topY], ['L', cr, bottomY], ['L', cl, bottomY], ['Z']], corkColor); addPath('cork-outline-' + i, [['M', cl, topY], ['L', cr, topY], ['M', cr, topY], ['L', cr, bottomY], ['M', cr, bottomY], ['L', cl, bottomY], ['M', cl, bottomY], ['L', cl, topY]], dark, { width: 2, cap: 'round', join: 'round' }); } var dimX = centers[0] - neckHalf - 24; addPath('h-dim', [['M', dimX, y0], ['L', dimX, initialY], ['M', dimX - 6, y0], ['L', dimX + 6, y0], ['M', dimX - 6, initialY], ['L', dimX + 6, initialY]], dark, { width: 1.5, cap: 'round' }); addLabel(metrics[4].contentId, dimX - 8, (y0 + initialY) / 2, 'right', 'middle', dark); for (var j = 1; j < 3; j++) { var uu = us[j]; var arrowX = centers[j] + neckHalf + 18; var endY = y0 + h * (1 - uu); var startY = initialY; addPath('x-arrow-' + j, [['M', arrowX, startY], ['L', arrowX, endY], ['M', arrowX - 6, endY + 10], ['L', arrowX, endY], ['L', arrowX + 6, endY + 10]], dark, { width: 1.5, cap: 'round', join: 'round' }); addLabel(metrics[j === 1 ? 5 : 6].contentId, arrowX + 8, (startY + endY) / 2, 'left', 'middle', dark); } addLabel(metrics[0].contentId, W / 2, H * 0.055, 'center', 'middle', dark); addLabel(metrics[1].contentId, W / 2, H * 0.11, 'center', 'middle', '#1f4e79'); addLabel(metrics[2].contentId, W / 2, H * 0.155, 'center', 'middle', '#1f4e79'); addLabel(metrics[3].contentId, margin, y0 - 10, 'left', 'bottom', baselineColor); addLabel(metrics[10].contentId, W / 2, initialY + 16, 'center', 'top', refColor); addLabel(metrics[7].contentId, centers[0], stageLabelY, 'center', 'top', dark); addLabel(metrics[8].contentId, centers[1], stageLabelY, 'center', 'top', dark); addLabel(metrics[9].contentId, centers[2], stageLabelY, 'center', 'top', dark); return { schemaVersion: 1, sceneId: 'cork-pull-stages', revision: input.revision, viewBox: { x: 0, y: 0, width: W, height: H }, paths: paths, root: { type: 'group', children: children } }; } };
